objective: Write a short pilot decision note about the main unresolved planning question for a mixed-interest Gyeongju group. Use only these constructed observations.
required_items: Separate a reported difficulty deciding what to do from a hypothesis about lodging.
State what remains unknown about other groups and what evidence could change the working hypothesis.

evidence.text: In this synthetic interview, one group struggled to choose activities that suited a heritage enthusiast and friends who wanted a barbecue.
The same group had already booked a pool villa before asking for suggestions. No other groups were interviewed.
